examples.title: Mystic rose
examples.description: Joins twelve points on a circle with every possible line in high-resolution graphics, changing colour as it goes; type TEXT afterwards to clear the screen.

examples.title: How many days old are you?
examples.description: Asks your age in years and works out roughly how many days, hours and minutes that makes.

examples.title: I will guess your number
examples.description: Think of a number from 1 to 100 and answer H for higher, L for lower or Y for yes; the MPF-II needs at most seven guesses. Q quits after a round.

manuals.title: Micro-Professor MPF-II User's Manual
manuals.note: Owner's manual (Multitech, 1982); scan in the Computer History Museum collection, PDF linked from the catalogue page
